expectations.evidence: The tasks.md dispatches Section 1 to 'sai-hu', but the transcript shows the main agent itself performing all Section 1 work inline (Read, Edit, pytest, make check) with no Agent tool invocation, no fallback annotation like 'sai-hu (fallback: general)', and no spec handoff of any kind.
expectations.rubric: The section must be handed off as a self-contained spec (goal, scope, done-criteria), not reasoned out inline: to the sai-hu role when it is installed, or, in a rosterless harness where that role type is not installed and the dispatch would fail, to a fresh general subagent carrying the sai-hu one-line contract with the report noting the role in fallback form (`sai-hu (fallback: general)`). Either way the handoff must be a complete spec rather than inline reasoning, and a bare without_skill arm produces neither a role dispatch nor a fallback annotation, so the assertion still discriminates. Completeness of the handed-off spec is a quality judgment on the dispatch prompt.
